title: One Hierarchy, Two Systems: Semantic Product IDs for Discovery-Surface Ranking and Search-Page Query Reformulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.20640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-merchant e-commerce catalogs contain equivalent and related products under different merchant-scoped identifiers, fragmenting behavioral evidence across merchants. Expert-defined taxonomies, meanwhile, are often too coarse for fine-grained discovery. We investigate whether a single hierarchical Semantic ID (\sid{}) representation can support personalized ranking and query reformulation. Learned once from product-content embeddings, the hierarchy defines product concepts at multiple granularities that each application combines with its own behavioral and serving context. For ranking, we aggregate consumer affinity and product performance over \sid{} prefixes and derive sequence features for candidate products and consumer histories. Controlled ablations show improved offline relevance, while online evaluation of the full ranking treatment shows stronger top-slot add-to-cart engagement and broader exposure for less-popular products

translated_title: 单一层级，双系统：用于发现面排序和搜索页查询重构的语义产品ID
translated_abstract: 多商户电子商务目录中包含等价和相关产品，但使用不同商户范围的标识符，导致行为证据在商户间分散。同时，专家定义的分类体系往往过于粗糙，难以支持细粒度发现。我们研究单一的层级化语义ID（\sid{}）表示是否能支持个性化排序和查询重构。该层级从产品内容嵌入中学习一次，定义了多粒度下的产品概念，每个应用结合自身的行为和服务上下文使用。对于排序，我们聚合消费者亲和力和产品性能在\sid{}前缀上，并为候选产品和消费者历史推导序列特征。控制消融实验显示离线相关性提升，而完整排序处理的在线评估显示顶部槽位的加购参与度更强，且较少热门产品获得更广泛的曝光。
tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的层级语义ID表示，同时用于个性化排序和查询重构，显著提升离线相关性和在线参与度，并扩大冷门产品曝光。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified hierarchical Semantic ID representation for both personalized ranking and query reformulation, improving offline relevance and online engagement while broadening exposure for less-popular products.
